description: This is a comprehensive HTML source file for a web-based database visualizer frontend. It contains structure, styles, and client-side JavaScript logic to load databases, tables, and display table data dynamically with interactive features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching data.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables, and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays the tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders provided data into an HTML table within the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content based on data type and size.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects.
